title: Add grocery items and social media link sharing to chat

requirements.text: Update the Message data type in backend/main.mo to support a new messageType field with variants for text, groceryList, and socialMediaLink

quotes: in the chat give feature to send grocerie items and send social media links

acceptanceCriteria: Message type includes a variant field that can be 'text', 'groceryList', or 'socialMediaLink'
Existing text messages continue to work without breaking changes
The messageType field is properly serialized and deserialized

requirements.text: Extend the Message data structure in backend/main.mo to include an optional groceryItems field that stores an array of grocery item strings when messageType is groceryList
acceptanceCriteria: groceryItems field accepts an array of text strings
Field is only populated when messageType is 'groceryList'
Backend stores and retrieves grocery items correctly

requirements.text: Extend the Message data structure in backend/main.mo to include an optional socialMediaUrl field that stores the URL string when messageType is socialMediaLink
acceptanceCriteria: socialMediaUrl field accepts a text string containing the URL
Field is only populated when messageType is 'socialMediaLink'
Backend stores and retrieves social media URLs correctly

requirements.text: Update the backend sendMessage method in main.mo to accept and validate grocery item arrays and social media URLs based on the messageType parameter
acceptanceCriteria: sendMessage accepts messageType, groceryItems, and socialMediaUrl parameters
Validation ensures groceryItems is provided when messageType is 'groceryList'
Validation ensures socialMediaUrl is provided when messageType is 'socialMediaLink'
Method returns appropriate error messages for invalid input

requirements.text: Update the useSendMessage mutation hook in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts to support sending messages with messageType, groceryItems array, and socialMediaUrl parameters
acceptanceCriteria: Hook accepts optional groceryItems and socialMediaUrl in mutation variables
Hook properly serializes grocery items array and social media URL for backend
Mutation invalidates message queries after successful send

requirements.text: Add a grocery list composer UI in the Chat page (frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx) that allows users to add multiple grocery items to a list with an input field and add/remove buttons, then send the complete list as a single message
acceptanceCriteria: Users can type grocery item names and add them to a temporary list
UI shows all items in the current grocery list with remove buttons
A 'Send Grocery List' button sends all items as a single groceryList message
The grocery list UI clears after successful send

requirements.text: Add a social media link input field in the Chat page (frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx) that accepts URLs and sends them as socialMediaLink messages with basic URL validation
acceptanceCriteria: Input field accepts text URLs
Basic validation checks for valid URL format (http/https)
A 'Send Link' button sends the URL as a socialMediaLink message
Input clears after successful send

requirements.text: Update the message display logic in Chat.tsx to render grocery list messages as formatted lists with checkboxes or bullet points showing all items in the groceryItems array
acceptanceCriteria: Grocery list messages display with a distinct visual style (e.g., card or bordered section)
Each grocery item appears as a list item with checkbox or bullet point
The message shows the sender and timestamp like regular messages

requirements.text: Update the message display logic in Chat.tsx to render social media link messages with link preview cards showing the URL as a clickable hyperlink that opens in a new tab
acceptanceCriteria: Social media link messages display with a distinct visual style (e.g., card with link icon)
URL is rendered as a clickable link with target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'
The message shows the sender and timestamp like regular messages
Link preview card includes visual indication that it's a link (icon, underline, or distinct styling)

requirements.text: Add a message type selector or toggle buttons in the Chat page UI that allows users to switch between sending regular text messages, grocery lists, and social media links
acceptanceCriteria: UI provides clear options to select message type (text, grocery list, social media link)
Selecting a message type shows the appropriate input interface
The selected message type is visually indicated
Users can easily switch between message types

constraints: Do not change the existing Message type in a way that breaks existing text message functionality
Maintain compatibility with the single-actor backend architecture in backend/main.mo
nonGoals: Implementing rich link previews with thumbnails or metadata scraping from external URLs
Adding grocery item autocomplete or suggestions
Enabling users to check off or mark grocery items as purchased
Supporting other message types beyond text, grocery lists, and social media links
